rollout_controller_cost.scope: Actual original Controller.generate metric ledger only; question rows before five-leaf expansion; native emitted scalar counts include DP padding; prefill is submitted token events, not unique KV/FLOPs. Costs include inherited ledger conventions; cached savings and worker CPU are not inferred. Credit/write/skip decisions join separately by attempt_id.

diagnostic_check_cost.scope: policy batch read-only checks and prior-rollout hash IO; excludes actor update and publication IO

shared_prefix_credit.scope: fixed selected leaves; sum of original scalar advantage / leaf effective length

record.scope: Actual original Controller.generate metric ledger only; question rows before five-leaf expansion; native emitted scalar counts include DP padding; prefill is submitted token events, not unique KV/FLOPs. Costs include inherited ledger conventions; cached savings and worker CPU are not inferred. Credit/write/skip decisions join separately by attempt_id.

interpretation.accepted_and_discarded: Disjoint outcomes. fallback is an overlapping recorded flag; in this snapshot all fallback candidates are accepted training leaves.
interpretation.candidate_costs: Sums of recorded per-candidate fields; inherited prefix sums are repeated inherited token events, not unique emissions or newly generated tokens.
interpretation.amortized_candidate_times: Recorded equal candidate shares of parallel round elapsed; outcome shares are amortized accounting, not separately measured candidate or outcome wall time.
interpretation.round_wall_times: Each distinct round_id is counted once. Stage sums are sequential candidate-round elapsed only; full rollout wall is reported separately.
interpretation.controller_ledger: Round ledger includes native DP padding. Residual between round ledger and candidate rows remains unallocated; no padding share is inferred by candidate/outcome.
interpretation.root_rows: 512 questions x 2 original roots = 1024 root leaves; 1536 accepted continuation candidates yield 2560 training leaves. Discarded candidates incur generation/retrieval/scoring but are not added to training leaves.
interpretation.completed_rollout_not_optimizer_credit: ROLLOUT_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE is rollout completion; outer/optimizer credit belongs to mainline progress records.

missing_or_not_separately_measured: Padding token/prefill cost attribution by individual candidate or accepted/discarded/fallback outcome.
Exclusive wall time for each candidate or each outcome inside a shared parallel round.
Unique KV/FLOPs, actual cached-prefill savings, worker CPU or GPU time, and money cost.
Original root per-trajectory generation, retrieval, scoring and prefix detail in candidate_attempts.
New mathematical audit or recomputation of rewards/advantages/variance (existing mainline stage metrics copied unchanged).
